name: CapWay
long_description:
CapWay is a financial technology company that creates financial access and opportunity for all via our ecosystem, including digital banking tools, savings tools, financial content, and inclusion consumer fintech products. 

The company fills financial gaps and provides solutions for the growing cashless economy and those who are looking to move away from the traditional financial system, including those who have been misunderstood, overlooked, and underserved.

CapWay has a B2C and B2B2C customer acquisition strategy.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Sheena Allen is a tech entrepreneur, author, and creative strategist passionate about building innovative solutions. 

She founded Sheena Allen Apps while in college and later launched CapWay, a fintech platform expanding economic access through inclusive digital banking. As CapWay’s founder, she became the youngest woman in the U.S. to own and operate a digital bank. She now co-leads GRITS, a launchpad for entrepreneurs, and is developing a fintech-AI startup.

news.title: CapWay Launches Inclusive Digital Bank With Finance-Inspired Lifestyle Products and Services
